name: Music streaming
definition: plan giving on-demand access to a library of recorded music.

name: Satellite and internet radio
definition: Paid subscription to a network of radio channels received by satellite or over the internet.

name: Audiobook subscription
definition: Plan giving access to a catalogue of audiobooks to listen to while subscribed. Titles bought with its credits are in Digital Media & Items.

name: Paid podcast
definition: paid plan giving access to one or more podcasts' paid episodes or feeds.

name: Video streaming
definition: Plan giving on-demand access to a streamed library of film, series or sport; live-sport services are here too.

name: Live TV streaming
definition: plan streaming a bundle of linear TV channels over the internet (vMVPD).

name: Pay-TV package
definition: Package of TV channels delivered by cable, satellite or IPTV, unless it is sold as part of a phone and internet bundle.

name: Newspaper subscription
definition: Subscription to one newspaper title, delivered in print, digitally or both.

name: Magazine subscription
definition: Subscription to one magazine title, delivered in print, digitally or both.

name: News and magazine library
definition: plan giving access to a library of many newspaper and magazine titles.

name: E-book subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of e-books to read while subscribed.

name: Comic and manga subscription
definition: plan giving access to a library of comics or manga to read while subscribed.

name: Online class subscription
definition: Plan giving access to a library of recorded or streamed lessons, sessions or classes to watch or listen to, whatever the subject.

name: Game subscription
definition: plan giving access to a catalogue of games, online play or cloud play on a platform or store.

name: Single-game subscription
definition: subscription required or sold to play one game.

name: Season or battle pass
definition: pass bought for a season of one game that unlocks its reward track.

name: Stock library subscription
definition: Plan giving access to a library of images, video, sounds, fonts or templates for making work. Each item licensed under it is in Digital Media & Items.

name: Multi-service bundle
definition: One plan bundling several subscription services, filed here when it is named for none of them.

name: Creator membership
definition: Paid membership giving one creator's paid posts, channel or feed, whatever the medium. A free follow is not included.

name: Cloud storage plan
definition: plan giving online storage for the user's files, with sync between devices.

name: Online backup plan
definition: plan keeping the user's backup on the provider's servers, even with its own client program.

name: Email service
definition: Mailbox and address service, free or paid. A program used only to read and send mail is in Software.

name: Messaging and video calls
definition: service for sending messages and making voice or video calls and meetings over the internet.

name: Maps and navigation service
definition: online map and route-finding service, free or paid.

name: Web hosting plan
definition: Plan renting server space for a personal website or game server. Hosting sold as business infrastructure is not included.

name: Mobile phone plan
definition: Mobile plan for calls, texts and data on a SIM or eSIM, contract or prepaid, with or without a handset. The handset is its own object.

name: Mobile data plan
definition: mobile plan giving data only, for a data SIM, dongle or mobile router.

name: Broadband plan
definition: Home internet plan over a fixed line: fibre, copper or cable.

name: Satellite internet plan
definition: Internet plan delivered by satellite through a dish, at home or on the move.

name: Home phone plan
definition: plan for a fixed home telephone line.

name: Phone, internet and TV bundle
definition: One plan bundling an internet or phone connection with phone or TV, sold as a package.

name: Travel eSIM plan
definition: Travel data plan on an eSIM that renews each period. One-off data packs are not included.

name: Gym or pool membership
definition: Membership of one operator's facility or facilities, such as a gym, pool, sports centre or climbing wall.

name: Club membership
definition: membership of a club joined to take part in its activity (sports, social or hobby).

name: Class pass
definition: Pass giving bookings at classes across many studios, often paid in renewing credits.

name: Multi-site membership
definition: Membership giving entry to one body's network of sites.

name: Multi-venue pass
definition: pass giving entry to many bodies' venues under one scheme.

name: Annual pass
definition: Annual pass or membership for one museum, zoo, garden, aquarium or theme park.

name: Transit pass
definition: Pass for travel on a network or route, valid for a period or a number of journeys.

name: Car-sharing membership
definition: Membership giving access to a shared vehicle fleet. Trips, hire fees and fuel are one-off services and not included.

name: Season ticket
definition: Ticket giving entry to a season or series of events at a venue or of a club.

name: Curated box
definition: Recurring delivery whose contents the provider picks, including a merchant's case plan.

name: Meal kit and menu plan
definition: Recurring delivery whose contents the member picks from the provider's menu, such as meal kits, coffee or books.

name: Producer club
definition: A producer's own club that allocates its own goods to members on a schedule.

name: Rental subscription
definition: Subscription lending goods to be used and returned, such as clothes, furniture, toys, instruments or art. The rented goods are not owned.
